searchText: MSRP $282,256. The 2026 Fleetwood Bounder 33C for sale at Motor Home Specialist; the #1 Volume Selling Motor Home Dealership in the World. Features Motion Power Lounge Hide-A-Loft Solar Electrical Panel Steering Stabilizer System Ford Driver Assist Technology Package King Bed Fireplace More About This RV Get ready to live in this coach with all the amenities of home, yet your destination can change when you like! The rear bedroom offers a slide out king bed with CPAP storage above, plus wardrobes, a dresser and an LED TV to watch at night. The full bathroom offers a 24' x 40' shower with a seat so you can relax after shopping in town or hiking the trails. When you get hungry, the full kitchen offers a residential refrigerator, a convection microwave and pantry for all your goodies. The jackknife sofa and end table are across from the LED TV with a fireplace below for a great place to watch your shows, and the rest EZ dinette gives you a place to dine and even work if you need to. You can also enjoy your coffee while sitting in the driver and passenger seats that swivel with a pedestal table in between. With any Bounder Class A gas motorhome by Fleetwood, you can travel in luxury and style with the power you desire to enjoy the ride as much as the destination. Beginning with the Power Platform Ford chassis, the enhanced safety features such as remote, power-heated mirrors with turn indicators and side cameras, and the color monitor for side and rear cameras, traveling is made easy. There is also an automotive one-piece windshield, a 100W solar panel, and WiFi Ranger Sky4 that come standard. A 5.5kW Onan generator will keep you powered up and you'll find plenty of storage both inside and out for personal belongings, camp gear, and more. Inside you will love the look of the durable, hand-laid Tarkett flooring, the energy efficient LED flush mount ceiling lighting, and the fiberglass shower with a glass door. Choose a Bounder Class A gas coach to discover even more stand-out features!
